title: FTSE Russell Q3 2027 quarterly review takes effect at the open — IPO adds from the May-July window, buffered shares-in-issue and free-float updates, and the Russell US Style capping recap, all implementing after the 2027-09-17 quad-witching close
source: EST: owner-published standing rule, re-derived first-hand by this lane rather than inherited from the proposal. FTSE Russell, "Frequently Asked Questions — Russell US Equity Indexes", July 2026 (lseg.com dam policy-documents, ftse-faq-document-russell-us-equity-2026.pdf), re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 198,134 bytes) and text-extracted in-session by inflating its 19 content streams — the byte and stream counts five sibling ledgers have now recorded, which is the check that this is the same edition. TWO GOVERNING TABLES, both read at the column level this session. (1) "Quarterly Addition Guidelines" publishes the STANDING RULE beside two dated columns: Rank Date "Last working day in January and July", Announce Date "Fourth Friday prior to the effective date (after market close)", Effective Date "Third Friday of the month", footnoted "** After the close on the third Friday of the month" and "* If a date falls on a holiday the previous business day is used"; its dated columns are headed "2026 First-Quarter Additions" and "2026 Third-Quarter Additions" and read 30 January 2026 / 31 July 2026 (rank), 20 February 2026 / 21 August 2026 (announce), 23 March 2026 / 21 September 2026 (effective). (2) A four-column dated schedule table publishes, for the September 2026 column: Query Period 21 August to 4 September 2026, Lock-Down Period (open of) 7 September 2026, Russell US Style Capping Cut-Off 9 September 2026, Review Effective Date (open of) 21 September 2026, Quarter-end Capping Cut-Off 25 September 2026, Quarter-end Capping Effective (open of) 30 September 2026. THE RULE REPRODUCES EVERY PUBLISHED VALUE, AND THIS LANE SETTLED THE ONE ANCHOR THE RULE IS AMBIGUOUS ABOUT: the "fourth Friday prior to the effective date" announce rule reproduces BOTH published announce dates only when the anchor is the THIRD FRIDAY (20 March / 18 September 2026), not the effective Monday — anchored on the Monday it returns 27 February and 28 August 2026, a week late in both columns. The style capping cut-off is exactly twelve calendar days before the effective Monday in all FOUR published columns; the lock-down opens on the Monday eleven calendar days before the implementation Friday in three of the four, matching the FAQ's own prose rule ("the lockdown begins on the Monday at the open, two weeks prior to implementation"), with June's three-week window the documented exception. SEPTEMBER 2027 THEREFORE READS: IPO inclusion window 2027-05-01 to 2027-07-31 (the FAQ's "IPOs which initially price/trade between May 1 and Jul 31"), rank date Friday 2027-07-30 (the last working day in July 2027 — the 31st is a Saturday), announce Friday 2027-08-20 after the close, lock-down opening Monday 2027-09-06, style capping cut-off Wednesday 2027-09-08, implementation after the close of Friday 2027-09-17 — the third Friday, tracked here as the CONFIRMED opex-2027-09-17 — effective at the open of Monday 2027-09-20. A STRUCTURAL TELL THAT CORROBORATES THE LOCK-DOWN LEG, re-verified this session: 2027-09-06 is Labor Day, and the owner's OWN published September 2026 lock-down date, 7 September 2026, was Labor Day 2026 — the rule is applied literally in this column without a holiday step, which is the one place a derived date could otherwise have drifted a session. The 2027 dates are RULE-DERIVED, NOT PUBLISHED: the FAQ's dated tables carry 2026 columns only, the string "2027" appears nowhere in the document, and it closes "NOTE: Dates may be subject to change. Clients will be notified of any changes." Filed estimate on the standing counts: this lane never self-confirms an event it researched, and the confirmed-tier prefixes in market-events-data.ts have no member for an index owner's own published schedule
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN 2026-09-09 by this event's own never-assessed initial research (docs/research/events/russell-quarterly-ipo-review-effective-2027-09-20.md). The id existed only as proposals/russell-quarterly-ipo-review-effective-2027-09-20.from-russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2027-09-30.json, which was read in full first per the "your own event was proposed by others" rule; that proposal is now shadowed and stays where it is. Its date arithmetic was re-derived independently and AGREES on every leg — the one thing this lane adds is the PROOF of which anchor the announce rule uses, which the proposal asserted without: the third Friday, not the effective Monday, verified against both published 2026 columns. SCOPE, RE-READ FROM THE OWNER: a quarterly review implements THREE things — the IPO additions from the 2027-05-01 to 2027-07-31 window under the July rank date, buffered quarterly shares-in-issue and free-float updates across existing constituents, and the Russell US Style capping recap struck at the 2027-09-08 cut-off. It carries NO cap-tier migration and NO style re-scoring; those are reconstitution legs. SHARPENING ON THE MARCH SIBLING'S SCOPE CORRECTION: the FAQ's prose says IPOs "will be reviewed quarterly for inclusion", but its Quarterly Addition Guidelines table publishes exactly TWO cycles a year (First-Quarter and Third-Quarter Additions) with rank dates only in January and July. Those reconcile only one way — Q2 and Q4 IPOs enter at the June and December SEMI-ANNUAL RECONSTITUTIONS instead, so the four annual entry points are March review, June recon, September review, December recon, and only two of them are quarterly reviews. THE QUAD-WITCHING CORRIDOR IS RULE-CERTAIN, NOT A DRAW: because the effective open is always the Monday after the third Friday, every instance of this event lands on the first session after a quarterly expiration. BUT SEPTEMBER 2027 IS THE CLEANEST INSTANCE THIS CLASS HAS ON THE BOOKS — this calendar tracks only THREE events within five days of it (fomc-2027-09-15 high, vix-expiration-2027-09-15, opex-2027-09-17 high/confirmed) against TWENTY-SIX for the 2026-09-21 sibling and TEN for the 2027-03-22 one. If the September cell is ever to be read as a Russell result rather than a macro one, this is the least-contaminated instance in the tracked calendar; the ledger still says stand aside, and says why. ONE WRINKLE THIS LANE DISCOVERED AND FILED: Tokyo cash is SHUT on 2027-09-20 (Respect for the Aged Day) and again on 2027-09-23 (Autumnal Equinox), proposed as jpx-market-closure-2027-09-20 and jpx-market-closure-2027-09-23 from two independent primary sources — the exact configuration jpx-market-closure-2027-03-22 already documents for the March sibling's own effective open. A TAKING LANE'S FIRST JOB: re-fetch the FTSE Russell FAQ and settle these dates against the owner's own 2027 column if one has been published by then; no owner document read on 2026-09-09 carries a 2027 column at all.
